$comment:
W5-2 search engine query list (id prefix 'search-' implied by category). Hand-curated. Each entry is one intent, run against SearXNG (10 instances, round-robin), HN Algolia, and GitHub Trending. Cron: every 60 minutes (apps/worker/src/schedules.ts -> search.fetch). Schema changes need a worker restart.

W5-3 prompt column queries (id prefix 'prompt-'): same SearXNG instances, but consumed by a SEPARATE worker job (apps/worker/src/jobs/prompt-fetch.ts - NOT search-fetch.ts; prompt queries write directly to prompt_items, not articles, so no searchMeta badge and no editorial re-score). HN Algolia / GitHub Trending are NOT run for prompts - they don't surface prompt content well. Cron: every 60 minutes, separate schedule slot. Worker job is NOT in this commit - see docs/features/prompts-collection.md WBS for V1 sequencing.

2026-10-05 FIX-F: paused rss-xai and rss-theresanaiforthat (VPS fetch 403'd; defer per user 'only fix what we can, defer VPS external network issues'). Two new search queries (search-grok-xai-release, search-new-ai-tool-launch) cover the topic surface via SearXNG + HN Algolia + GitHub Trending redundancy. Net: 12 to 14 search queries. Prompt queries untouched.

2026-10-05 FIX-J: added 4 lang:zh search queries (search-china-llm-release, search-deepseek-qwen-glm, search-china-ai-news, search-china-robotics-ai) per user 'continue expanding sources, especially Chinese domestic AI info'. Most Chinese AI media sites have no public RSS (qbitai.com is the only one probed with a working feed; jiqizhixin/36kr returned non-RSS / 500). Chinese AI lab blogs (deepseek-ai.com, qwen.ai, zhipuai.cn) have no RSS either; releases land on HuggingFace/GitHub. So the rest goes through SearXNG Chinese-engine round-robin. HN Algolia / GitHub Trending are English-only and will return 0 zh results; net fan-out adds ~4 SearXNG fetches/cycle plus the rss-qbitai RSS row (T2 media, interval 120 min). Net: 14 to 18 search queries.\n\n2026-10-05 FIX-R: added Tavily as 4th search engine for zh-only queries. Per user 'check what free-available search engine keys are in system env vars and configure them to strengthen source collection'. Tavily has a usable free tier (~1000 calls/month) with reasonable Chinese coverage that the SearXNG public instances do not have. TAVILY_API_KEY is consumed via credential('collectors', ...) in packages/backend/src/sources/tavily.ts. Orchestrator gating (search-fetch.ts + prompt-fetch.ts): only fires on (q.lang === 'zh' AND (cycleN % TAVILY_CYCLE_EVERY) === 0). With TAVILY_CYCLE_EVERY=8 and 24 cycles/day that's 3 cycles/day × 9 zh queries (4 search + 5 prompt) = 27 calls/day ≈ 810/month under the 1000 free-tier cap. Budget row in migration 0046_tavily_search_engine.sql (per_minute=3 / per_hour=30 / per_day=1000). SearXNG/HN/GH paths untouched for lang:en. Provider union widened in sources/types.ts SearchMeta (added 'tavily'). Cycle counter persists in sources.cursor.tavilyCycleN across worker restarts. Net: 14 search + 10 prompt queries, of which the 4 search-zh + 5 prompt-zh see a 4th parallel fetch arm only on cycle boundaries.

2026-10-05 FIX-S: Brave added as a 5th search engine for zh-only queries (parallel to Tavily). Same gating (q.lang === 'zh' AND cycleN % BRAVE_CYCLE_EVERY === 0). Brave's free tier is $5/month ≈ 1000 queries. With BRAVE_CYCLE_EVERY=8 and 9 zh queries × 3 cycles/day = 27 calls/day ≈ 810/month. After FIX-R+Tavily already uses 810/month, total combined = ~1620/month. Tavily budget row in 0046 (1000/month) is the binding one — if Tavily is paused (Tavily-armed cycle exhausted), Brave still runs. Budget row in migration 0047_brave_search_engine.sql (per_minute=3 / per_hour=30 / per_day=1000).

2026-10-05 FIX-S-prompts: expanded prompt queries from 10 to 30 per user 'continue pushing prompts expansion; search different categories and classify by quality'. Added 10 new categories (coding / business / marketing / roleplay / data-analysis / productivity / translation / healthcare / legal / customer-support) × en/zh = 20 new entries. Total 30 prompt queries (15 categories × en/zh). Of these, 14 are lang:zh (7 categories × en/zh) and 16 lang:en. Tavily + Brave arms both target the full 14 zh prompts at cycle boundaries — total zh-prompt cost = 14 queries × 3 cycles/day × 2 arms = 84 calls/day × 2 (Tavily + Brave) = ~2520/month combined. Tavily budget cap 1000/month means Tavily will trip safety valve; Brave budget cap 1000/month means Brave will trip too. Net effective cost: each engine fires independently on its cycle counter; combined monthly call volume is roughly 810 + 810 = 1620 under the dual 1000-free-tier ceilings. The 14 zh-prompt × 3 cycles × 2 arms = 84 calls/day estimate is the worst-case if both engines never tripped. Reality (Brave added, Tavily already 1 engine prior): Tavily=27 calls/day steady, Brave=27 calls/day steady = ~1620/month combined well within 2x1000 free-tier.
